I want to use this time to walk through the readiness review checklist and make sure we're solid before we ship. The checklist calls out tenant rate tiers, dependency-failure behavior, query controls, and customer-specific limits as things we need to address before Monday. I'd like to go item by item and hear where each of you stands.
